sloka: तावत्ते रावणस्येदं कुलं जन्म च राघव ।वरप्रदानं च तथा तस्मै दत्तं ब्रवीमि ते ।। ७.२.३ ॥
transliteration: tāvatte rāvaṇasyedaṁ kulaṁ janma ca rāghava ।varapradānaṁ ca tathā tasmai dattaṁ bravīmi te ।। 7.2.3 ॥

translations.english: O Raghava, I will now tell you about Ravana's lineage, his birth, and the boons that were granted to him.
